influences.name: Taka (ONE OK ROCK)
influences.context: That really impressed me, and I actually studied how they sing as part of my preparation for recording our own vocals.

influences.name: Kenta (WANIMA)
influences.context: He'd point out our unique qualities and tell us how to get more resonance. And so through discussions with him we developed our own vocal sound.

influences.name: Skrillex
influences.context: At the time, Skrillex was blowing up. I saw that. He just had all these crazy videos [of him] coming on stage and jumping around, he was just him being himself. And that was really shocking to me. That was pretty much why I was really into music.
